newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 80 mln kuna 42-day T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 80 mln kuna 42-day T-bills.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 80 million kuna through 42-day treasury bills.
The issue was priced at 98,750 kuna with the interest rate steady at 11 percent.

The ministry planned to sell 65 million kuna but bids totalled 91.7 million kuna at 6.4-11.0 percent. The weighted average was 10.7 percent. The bills are payable on December 12 and they mature on January 23.
The ministry will next auction 50 million kuna worth of 91-day T-bills on December 17.
